title: Spec docblock: FilterCondition form 4 (nested relation) says "one level" but the engine serves up to three hops
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

From the narrowing contract review of PR #35423 (seat 5, at `a5945f2a`; ungraded finding, for a card). Parent: #34990.

## What is false
`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` describes the nested-relation form (form 4 on `FilterCondition`) as "one level" (around lines 2222, 2235 and 2372). The engine serves a nested relation condition up to three hops, and since #35423 the dashboard drill sends relationship paths of up to three hops as nested conditions (`{ a: { b: { c: v } } }`). An author or agent reading the spec's own docs is told the deeper form is not served.

## Done when
The three docblock sentences state the engine's hop limit (and where it is enforced), and the generated reference docs that copy them are regenerated.

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:spec. Docs only; no behaviour changes.
